ev.cr.business_lines.subject: Group
ev.cr.business_lines.statement: The group's businesses are P&C reinsurance, life and health reinsurance, primary P&C insurance, asset management, insurance intermediary and other businesses.

ev.cr.history.subject: Group
ev.cr.history.statement: China Re originates from the People's Insurance Company of China (established October 1949) and was restructured into a joint-stock limited company in October 2007.

ev.cr.listing.subject: Group
ev.cr.listing.statement: China Re listed on the Main Board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on 26 October 2015 (stock code 1508).

ev.cr.shareholders.subject: Group
ev.cr.shareholders.statement: The Ministry of Finance holds 11.45% and Central Huijin Investment Ltd. holds 71.56% of China Re.

ev.cr.controlling_shareholder.subject: Group
ev.cr.controlling_shareholder.statement: The issuer identifies Central Huijin as its controlling shareholder.

ev.cr.ratings_issuer.subject: Group
ev.cr.ratings_issuer.statement: The issuer reports that during 2025 it maintained an "A (Excellent)" rating from A.M. Best and an "A" rating from S&P Global Ratings. Rating type and outlook are not stated there.

ev.cr.agri_decline.subject: P&C reinsurance segment
ev.cr.agri_decline.statement: The issuer attributes the 0.5% fall in P&C reinsurance segment insurance revenue mainly to lower earned premiums from domestic agriculture insurance business.

ev.cr.cat_losses.subject: Overseas P&C reinsurance and Chaucer
ev.cr.cat_losses.statement: The issuer reports that overseas P&C business was hit in H1 2025 by catastrophe losses, including the California wildfires and severe convective storms (SCS).

ev.cr.investment_yield.subject: Group
ev.cr.investment_yield.statement: Total investment yield was 4.66% in FY2025 versus 4.83% in FY2024 (issuer definition, note 4, p.20).

ev.cr.ifrs17.subject: Group
ev.cr.ifrs17.statement: The group has applied IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 from 1 January 2023, so FY2024-FY2025 figures share a basis but are not comparable with pre-2023 reporting.

gap.cr.geography.description: No revenue split by country or region was found in the two sources reviewed. The full FY2025 annual report has not been reviewed.
gap.cr.geography.suggested_action: Review the FY2025 annual report segment and geographic notes.

gap.cr.group_combined_ratio.description: No group-level combined ratio was found in the results announcement; only segment ratios are recorded.
gap.cr.group_combined_ratio.suggested_action: Check the annual report; otherwise present segment ratios with their scopes.

gap.cr.ratings_primary.description: Ratings are issuer-reported only. Agency rating type, action date, outlook and rationale have not been checked at A.M. Best or S&P.
gap.cr.ratings_primary.suggested_action: Retrieve the latest rating action from each agency.

gap.cr.solvency_minimum.description: Regulatory minimum solvency requirements (C-ROSS) are not sourced, so the headroom above minimum is not stated.
gap.cr.solvency_minimum.suggested_action: Cite the NFRA solvency rules for core and comprehensive minimums.

gap.cr.shareholder_support.description: The record shows who controls China Re, not whether or how the state would support it; no source on support willingness or capacity has been reviewed.
gap.cr.shareholder_support.suggested_action: Review rating agency support assessments (e.g. government-related issuer analysis).

gap.cr.risk_disclosures.description: The issuer's principal risk and risk-management disclosures have not been reviewed; the risks recorded are FY2025 performance pressure points only, and mitigants are not covered.
gap.cr.risk_disclosures.suggested_action: Review the annual report risk management section and any rating agency risk discussion.

gap.cr.solvency_audit.description: The 31 December 2025 solvency figures are unaudited per the issuer.
gap.cr.solvency_audit.suggested_action: Re-check against the audited or NFRA-published solvency report when available.

rules: Only change elements listed in scope_element_ids; new elements must fit inside scope_rect.
Never write financial figures as text. Show numbers with metric/table/barchart elements bound to an evidence_id from evidence_available.
Do not change evidence_id, refs, ids or types of existing elements, and do not remove citations.
If the instruction needs data that is not in evidence_available, add a research_requests entry instead of inventing a number.
Keep text concise and factual; interpretations must stay consistent with the cited claims.
